# Pull request

## Problem and change

Describe the problem, the observable change, and a related issue if one exists.
Keep security-sensitive details out of public PRs; use the [security process](https://github.com/ernestjsf/attro/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

## Verification

List exact commands and outcomes, tested revision/environment, and checks not run
with reasons. For docs-only changes, report link and diff checks; for package
changes, follow the owning fork's guidance.

## Risks and compatibility

Note affected configuration, dependencies, source pins, data, or user workflows.
If changing a fork, link its change and explain the matching root pin update.

- [ ] I reviewed the diff and removed secrets, personal configuration, and unrelated changes.
- [ ] I followed the [contribution guidance](https://github.com/ernestjsf/attro/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and retained applicable licenses/notices.
- [ ] User-visible behavior and known limitations are documented where relevant.
